kira: Console shows a trace link for trace_id=8a7f3c but when I open it the request headers are collapsed and I don't see X-Request-Id. Anyone got a quick checklist to find the original request logs by trace_id/req_id? :eyes:

leo: First quick checks — open the console 'View raw' for that span and search for request.headers or x_request_id. Sometimes headers get normalized (X-Request-Id vs x_request_id). Also check the span tags for http.request_id or request_id.

kira: @leo I tried raw, the span has trace_id: 8a7f3c and a few spans but no x-request-id and the gateway logs aren't linked. How do I jump from trace_id -> actual pod log lines?

marta: Two paths: the trace-search UI and the CLI. UI: https://observability.internal/trace-search — paste the trace_id, widen time window +/-30s and click 'Related logs'. If that fails, CLI flow: get spans then search logs by span ids.

marta: ```
# fetch spans for trace
curl -s "https://traces.internal/api/v1/traces/8a7f3c" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TRACE_TOKEN" | jq '.spans[] | {span_id: .span_id, service: .process.serviceName}'
# stream logs and look for the span id or trace id in logs
stern -n prod --selector app=edge-proxy --container=proxy | rg "8a7f3c" -n
```

sam: Also our log-search supports trace_id queries directly: ```
curl -s "https://logs.internal/api/search?q=trace_id:8a7f3c&from=1610000000&to=1610000100" -H "Authorization: Bearer $LOG_TOKEN" | jq -r '.hits[]._source | "["+(.timestamp)+"] " + .message'
```

leo: If the console collapsed headers the gateway may rewrite the header name (x-req-ref, x-redwood-req, etc). Quick kubectl check on ingress/edge pods:``` 
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=ingress -o name
kubectl -n prod logs <ingress-pod> | rg "8a7f3c|X-Request-Id|x-req-ref"
```

marta: If you want a brute-force one-liner to hunt across relevant pods (fast for narrow time window):``` 
P=8a7f3c
kubectl -n prod get pods -l 'app in (edge-proxy,api-server,ingress)' -o name | xargs -I{} kubectl logs -n prod {} --tail=500 | rg "$P"
```

ops-bot: alert: trace-search query latency spike detected for service=edge-proxy (rule: trace_search_slo) :warning:

kira: Great — I'll try trace-search first then the CLI span->logs flow if needed. If I still can't find gateway lines I'll paste the trace_id and a time window here. Thanks! :thumbsup:
